device.note: An emulator was already running and rooted (adbd running as root) when this agent started. It was not booted here. It was used read/write: `adb install` of 20 APKs and method traces written to /data/local/tmp/mine.

method.counted: distinct method signatures in a class whose name starts with android., java., javax. or dalvik.
method.recordFormat: 14-byte records: tid:u16le, (methodId<<2|kind):u16le, u32, u32, u16; kind 0=ENTER 1=EXIT 2=THREAD_CHANGE.
method.semantics: -S force-stops first so LaunchState is COLD; -W waits for the first frame and prints TotalTime; -P starts ART buffered method tracing (every method enter/exit, no sampling) which stops when the app reports idle.
method.window: process start -> first frame -> idle. The window is NOT "first frame inclusive": ART stops the trace at idle, so post-first-frame settle work is included. It is a COLD start, so no previous activity of this app is torn down inside the window.
